evidence.title: Friday v0.4.4 local application
evidence.locator: README.md opening workflow, Free and on your computer, automation/Git details, desktop/terminal setup and FAQ
evidence.finding: The release README describes a free local application with desktop packages and a localhost browser server, existing coding-tool logins, parallel agents/worktrees, product team task-board communication, automation triggers and Git/PR actions. It distinguishes paid hosted Friday Team.

evidence.title: Friday Claude Code adapter
evidence.finding: The Claude adapter selects the claude executable, native auth login/status and headless stream-json output, deliberately preserving the user native login.

evidence.title: Friday Codex app-server adapter
evidence.finding: The Codex adapter selects codex, native login/status, starts app-server and initializes its JSON-RPC connection. This is actual coding-harness integration, not merely an OpenAI model endpoint.

evidence.title: Friday Cursor Agent adapter
evidence.finding: The Cursor adapter launches cursor-agent, native login/status and headless stream-json with mode-specific permission flags.

evidence.title: Friday product-owned delegation and mail
evidence.locator: agent-mesh.ts list_agents/message_agent/ask_agent tools181–220; post_tasks302–338; dispatch1095–1108; lead notification862–873
evidence.finding: The product exposes named agent messages/questions, a shared task board with dependencies/review states, task assignment/claim/finish operations and a stored lead role. Dispatch handlers call product task methods and wake the lead; this is owned orchestration rather than an installed external skill.

evidence.title: Friday built-in agent MCP bridge
evidence.locator: friday-mcp.ts tools/list and tools/call handling86–98; ACP entry237–238
evidence.finding: The built-in bridge supplies Friday tools to launched coding agents and routes tool calls back to the session service.

evidence.title: Friday actual diff rendering
evidence.finding: The visible DiffView component renders hunk content and each added/removed source line inside code elements with sign and line-number information. It is an actual product code-diff interface; the separately downloaded cropped marketing review composition is not used as the primary image or sole proof.

evidence.title: Friday analytics controls and send gate
evidence.finding: Analytics are gated by stored sharing on, answered-notice told and absence of FRIDAY_NO_TELEMETRY/DO_NOT_TRACK. capture checks sharing before sending. The code separates product usage counts from model-provider traffic.

evidence.title: Friday documented telemetry choices
evidence.locator: README.md Privacy exactly what is sent, lines 223–237
evidence.finding: The release README documents a first-run usage-count question, no send before an answer, an in-app Share anonymous usage control under Settings Data&backup, and FRIDAY_NO_TELEMETRY/DO_NOT_TRACK environment overrides. It describes anonymous counts going to PostHog, not no telemetry.

evidence.title: Friday application MIT license
evidence.finding: The local main application is MIT licensed free of charge. This license does not establish the implementation/license or price of the separately hosted Friday Team service.
